renewal_terms: Automatically renewable on an annual basis for one-year terms for up to another 10 years under the same terms and conditions
key_obligations: $500,000 irrevocable Letter of Credit required at commencement, renewed bimonthly

risk_flags.issue: Automatic annual renewals for up to ten additional years without explicit customer consent or right to terminate early
risk_flags.suggested_redline: Add a clause allowing the Distributor to terminate the Agreement upon 90 days' written notice at any time during the Term

risk_flags.issue: Broad mutual indemnification scope could expose the Distributor to significant liability for third-party claims
risk_flags.suggested_redline: Limit indemnification obligations to direct damages only and exclude consequential or indirect damages where possible

recommendation: The document is unsigned and contains high-severity risks related to automatic renewals locking the Distributor into a long-term commitment with limited exit options. Recommend adding a termination clause allowing the Distributor to terminate upon 90 days' written notice at any time during the Term. Also, limit indemnification obligations to direct damages only and exclude consequential or indirect damages where possible.
